text:
sasha_csm: Flagging Clearwave (mid-market). Weekly usage dropped ~40% month-over-month. Renewal ~26 days. Proposing a short retention play: a hands-on lab, a timeboxed credit offer, quick eng triage with a safe fallback, and an outcomes checklist to measure adoption.

maria_cs: Oof. Are they on hosted or private? any infra issues?

sasha_csm: Hosted. No infra events. Primary calls were about rerank accuracy and slower p50 on some queries.

jon_sales: Follow-up from my call: they switched to rerank-v3 and noticed inconsistency on their payments examples. Also their token spend spiked unexpectedly.

ada_se: @jon_sales pls paste the exact reproduction steps and any sample run ids so eng can repro.

jon_sales: drop-in notes:
```
- Enabled rerank-v3 on invoices pipeline
- Observed ~10pt drop in top-1 accuracy on 500 sampled runs
- Median latency increased ~120ms on long prompts
- Billing jump ~22% month-over-month
```

kevin_eng: That looks like both quality and cost friction. Suggest quick experiment: one arm with rerank-v3 + tuned threshold, other arm fallback to rerank-v2. Measure top-1 accuracy and p50 latency over 800 runs. If p50 > 400ms or accuracy drops >7pts, auto-fallback.

ada_se: For the outreach, here's a compact template to send before the lab (I edited):
```
Hi Clearwave team,
We saw a drop in activity after you switched to rerank-v3. Can we run a 45-minute hands-on lab to walk prompts, rerank thresholding, and a safe rollback plan? Please include two sample run IDs so our engineers can reproduce. If adoption doesn't recover after remediation, we're prepared to issue a 15% usage credit for 30 days while we work with you.
Thanks, Sasha + team
```

ops-bot: scheduled job #11022 -> started at 1729990120, ETA 12m. CI logs: https://ci.redwood/test/11022

maria_cs: I recommend we keep the first sync to CSM+AE+SE. If lab doesn't move metrics, escalate to exec sync.

sasha_csm: Agreed. Quick decision tree:
- If A/B shows tune fixes quality -> close risk and remove CRM flag
- If not fixable quickly -> prep downgrade path (phased capacity reduction, preserve basic API access, final rollback instructions) and set a 7-day decision window before renewal

jon_sales: I'll draft the credit/legal wording: short and conditional. Planning wording: "One-time 15% usage credit for 30 days, contingent on participation in remediation activities and active troubleshooting." I'll loop in legal if they request custom terms.

ada_se: Feedback tracker row to paste into the ticket: 
```
- symptom: (quality|latency|cost|integration)
- sample: run ids + short text
- severity: (low|med|high)
- immediate_action: (fallback|tune|credit)
- owner: @name
- due: YYYY-MM-DD
```

kevin_eng: I'll own the A/B and report back within 24h of getting sample runs. If we see replicated failure, propose fallback to v2 with tuned threshold and reduced batching.

sasha_csm: Action items (owners + due):
- Send outreach + schedule lab (sasha_csm) - due 1729990600
- Draft credit text & legal check (jon_sales) - due 1729990400
- Run A/B and post results (kevin_eng + ops-bot) - ETA 1729990800
- Create ticket with feedback row & attach sample runs (ada_se) - due 1729990500
- Add CRM renewal-risk tag + priority (maria_cs) - done

maria_cs: I'll join the lab to capture commitments and next steps.

sasha_csm: If A/B shows a tunable fix, we close and offer enable follow-up materials. If not, we prepare the downgrade checklist:
- Notify customer 10 days before change
- Reduce reserved capacity to X% in phased steps over 5 days
- Provide re-enablement steps and a test-run checklist

jon_sales: Also ask them to share their latest prompts and any post-processing heuristics before the lab so eng can pre-check.

ada_se: Added that ask to the template.

sasha_csm: I'll send the outreach now and update this thread with the lab invite and eng A/B outcome. Thanks team. :handshake:
